errors.forbidden: Only managers can create new tags. Pick an existing one.
errors.unknown: The tag could not be added. Try again.

notes.title: Notes
notes.healthWarning: Do not record health information in notes.
notes.deleteDescription: The note is hidden from staff. An admin can still see that it existed.
notes.error: The note could not be saved. Try again.

merge.title: Duplicate guests
merge.intro: These profiles look like the same person. Pick the profile to keep: visits, contacts, consents, tags and notes move onto it.
merge.keepFor: Keep this profile, {{name}}, and merge the other one into it
merge.confirmDescription: {{other}} will be merged into {{name}}. This cannot be undone from here; the audit log records it.
merge.error: The profiles could not be merged.

transfer.title: Import and export guests
transfer.noAccess: Only owners and admins can import or export guests.

export.title: Export
export.warning: The file contains personal data: names, phone numbers, email addresses and notes. Store it securely and delete it when you no longer need it. Each export is logged; you can export up to five times a day.
export.rateLimited: You have reached today's export limit. Try again tomorrow.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Upload a CSV with a header row. Imported contacts get no marketing consent. A transactional consent is recorded only for rows marked yes, with the consent text version you give.
import.failed: The import stopped. Rows already processed are saved; fix the file and import the rest.
